newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY SOFTER ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY SOFTER ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted marginally easier against hard currencies at the close of interbank trade on Monday, dealers said.
They added however that the local unit had hardly shifted from its opening levels during the lacklustre session.
"The market was generally quiet. There was very little trading and the dollar hardly moved from where it was in the morning," one dealer said.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 10.3300/3500 against the U.S. dollar compared to Friday's 10.3250/3450 and was at 16.1540/1930 from 16.1250/1660 against sterling.
It slipped to 2.2800/2860 versus the rand from 2.2770/2830 but was quoted firmer at 6.7650/7810 against the mark from 6.7830/7960.
